standard_taps: IF xiaomi_brightness_guard.brightness() < 300 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN light_up() xiaomi_smart_light

IF xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.get_illuminance() < 300 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN light_up() xiaomi_smart_light
IF xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.get_illuminance() > 300 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN light_down() xiaomi_smart_light
IF mijia_CO2_ultra_sensor.get_CO2_concentration() > 19 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN turn_on() mijia_air_purifier_MAX
IF mijia_CO2_ultra_sensor.get_CO2_concentration() > 19 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN turn_on() mijia_air_purifier
IF xiaomi_volume_sensor.reading() > 37 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN set_volume_low() xiaomi_television
IF xiaomi_volume_sensor.reading() < 34 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN set_volume_high() xiaomi_television
IF viomi_hood.reading() >= 0.15 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN power_on() viomi_hood
